name: Hana Suou
source:
Suou is a [URL=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nekomata]nekomata[/URL]. To put it positively, he's individualistic and moves at his own distinct pace. To put it negatively, he's completely out of whack in comparison to "normal" people. Suou's a misanthrope, but in reality, he's a contrarian who wants friends. He's always sunbathing on his own. Though he's extremely sensitive to the cold, he's also sensitive to the heat of hot foods and drinks, so he can't eat them.

[Translation of his [URL=http://www.honeybee-cd.com/ayakashi/chara_hana.html]official website character profile[/URL].]
